description: The age (age-encryption.org) recipients an atproto account can decrypt for. Prototype lexicon; see ../README.md.

main.description: A single record per account (rkey 'self') listing every native age recipient the account holder controls. Encrypting parties resolve the account by handle or DID, fetch this record with com.atproto.sync.getRecord, and verify the commit signature against the account's #atproto signing key before trusting it.

recipients.description: Recipients to wrap file keys to. An encrypting party wraps to all of them, so a file is readable by every listed key.

recipient.description: A native age recipient string: 'age1...' (X25519) or 'age1pq1...' (ML-KEM-768 + X25519 hybrid). Plugin recipients ('age1<name>1...') and SSH public keys are deliberately not allowed: a record fetched from the network must not be able to choose which plugin binary an encrypting party executes.

label.description: Optional human-readable name for the key, e.g. 'laptop' or 'yubikey backup'.

createdAt.description: When this recipient was added. Informational only.
